verdict.rationale: Shopify documents real outbound order webhooks: UCP-shaped payloads pushed to a registered endpoint on fulfillment, refund, return, edit or cancellation, HMAC-SHA256 signed, and retried up to 8 times over 4 hours. Order MCP docs name webhooks as the primary update channel. However, an agent cannot subscribe on its own: there is no self-serve subscription API, setup requires contacting a Shopify partner manager, and the profile webhook_url field is not honored. Coverage is limited to order events. Missing for 10: self-serve programmatic subscription/registration, event topics beyond orders, independent or hands-on corroboration of delivery.
